technical_summary: Customer runs a multi-tenant enterprise search for financial docs. Corpus ~120M documents (full-text + metadata); average doc length 600 tokens. Current pipeline: embeddings index (Faiss) + BM25 fallback; considering embedding model replacement and neural reranker for top-10. Target: 200 qps steady, peak 450 qps; p95 latency target for search (end-to-end) <250ms, reranker tail p99 <120ms. Index raw size ~12 TB after sharding/replicas. They plan reranker only on top-K (K=10) to control cost.
requirements_summary: Must support VPC deployment or dedicated private plane; audit logs for all token-level operations; key management via customer KMS; ability to pin embedding model and reranker versions; canary/A/B routing; quantization or batching recommendations to hit cost targets. Quality gate: offline delta NDCG@10 >= +0.01 and online MRR uplift >= +0.02 (or no more than -0.01 regression).
migration_plan: Phase 1: offline evals (embeddings candidates + reranker candidates) on held-out queries; Phase 2: baseline A/B in Dedicated dev cluster (5% traffic to new reranker) with real-time metrics and alerting; Phase 3: staged canary to 25% then 100% with automatic rollback policy; Phase 4: autoscaling and cost tuning using Redwood Optimize recommendations. Expect 8-10 week migration timeline for full index re-ingest and validation.
eval_strategy: Offline: compute NDCG@1/5/10, MRR, Recall@k on 10k human-labeled query set; run embedding model grid (3 candidates: 1024-d open model, 1536-d hybrid, quantized 1536-d) and reranker variants (small cross-encoder CPU, GPU-accelerated cross-encoder). Online: A/B for 30 days with monitoring for NPS proxies (click-through, dwell time) + latency/cost metrics. Canary policy: 72 hour minimum, require no quality regression beyond -0.01 NDCG@10 and latency/SLA within threshold.
